title: Almost as great as
body: 30/30, which disappeared years ago, though I loved it so much. Now you did this and it’s great, but please don’t bring any ai into this, please don’t! Then I willingly pay for your app.

title: Labor of love
body: This app was made with love and it shows. It wants you to feel delight when using it. It wants to make the tediousness of working through tasks as joyful as possible.
author: lukeantix7
